title: Apprentice
description:
🌟
 **Apprenticeship Opportunity** 
 🌟
 



  





**Phoenix Contact India Pvt. Ltd.** 
 is inviting applications for the role of
 **Apprentice** 
 under the
 **National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)** 
 .
 



  





 🔹
 **Eligibility Criteria** 




 • Qualification: B. Sc.
 



 • Graduation Year: 2024, 2025 \& 2026
 



 • Important: Only candidates with complete degrees and results in hand are eligible. No backlogs or awaited results will be entertained.
 



  





 🔹
 **Responsibilities** 



1. Support and Participate in Organizational Integrated Management.
2. Support for Execution of Supplier System Audit, Customer Audits as well as other Process improvement Audits.
3. Develop a support to Electronics Laboratory Engineers
4. Support to the Team for Data Analysis and Monthly reporting pertaining to the Department.
5. Support to Customer Requirements team for execution of Customer end requirements along with the internal Coordination with relevant stakeholders.
6. In maintenance of laboratory operation.



  





 🔹
 **Pay Range and Compensation Package** 




 • Stipend Range: INR 18,000 per month \+ Additional Benefit of Government share INR 6,150 per month under NATS
 



  





 🔹
 **What You’ll Gain** 




 • Hands‑on exposure to corporate processes in a German MNC environment
 



 • Structured learning under NATS framework
 



 • Opportunity to contribute to real‑time projects and operations
 



 • Skill development, mentorship, and career growth pathways
 



  





 📧Interested candidates may apply at: rsolanki@phoenixcontact.co.in
